brand: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE highly polished mobile app screen for Reno, a homeowner-controlled home improvement app launching in St. Augustine. Output a single flat edge-to-edge portrait app screenshot with aspect ratio approximately 9:19.5, no device bezel, no external background, no perspective, no presentation board, no extra screens. Full status bar 9:41 and bottom safe area. Visual system: warm ivory #F8F5EF background, dark forest #17332F text and primary buttons, terracotta #B84932 accents, pale lime #E4ECAC status chips, white cards, thin warm-gray rules. Distinctive small lowercase serif wordmark 'reno' with a tiny terracotta square. Large elegant contemporary serif page titles, clean highly legible sans serif UI and tabular monetary figures. Generous 24px side margins at a 390px logical width, 48px tall buttons, 16px body text. Restrained rounded 12px cards, no excessive shadows or gradients. Human, calm, precise, premium residential editorial aesthetic. Small monoline icons. Every piece of copy should be sharply readable, correctly spelled. Use exact supplied figures. All people, providers, costs and project data are fictional design examples. Do not put explanatory labels outside the app.
